question: Which Andaman Island is named after Subhash Chandra Bose in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ross Island**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ross Island was renamed as Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Island in 2018.
 
• This renaming was done to honor the contributions of Subhash Chandra Bose to India's freedom struggle.
 
• Ross Island is one of the Andaman Islands, located about 3 km east of Port Blair.
 
• It was the administrative headquarters of the British in the Andaman Islands before an earthquake rocked it in 1941.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose** was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement against British colonial rule.
 
• He was the head of the Indian National Army (INA) and played a key role in mobilizing Indian expatriates and others to fight against British rule.
 
• Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose's legacy is celebrated annually on his birth anniversary, January 23rd.
